## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: narrow leadership concentrated in Technology (Top 5 are tech) alongside weak sector breadth, and multiple major divergence signals across 1W vs 1M moves.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Technology leads with clear winners: INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +15.44% | 1M: +31.32%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +14.05% | 1M: +36.51%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare shows pockets of strength: PFE (1W: +3.46% | 1M: +1.57%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +7.89% | 1M: -8.52%) RECOVERY.  

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Financials weak: JPM (1W: -3.08% | 1M: -5.08%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND; Communication and Industrials under pressure with ORCL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND and UPS (1W: -8.11% | 1M: -12.45%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +15.44% | 1M: +31.32%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +14.18% | 1M: -2.28%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +14.05% | 1M: +36.51%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +13.62% | 1M: -1.21%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: GD (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -12.37%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -7.27% | 1M: -9.63%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND, FDX (1W: -7.35% | 1M: -15.99%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -9.68%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Industrials and select Tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +17.09%), AMD (1W: +15.44%), LRCX (1W: +14.18%), META (1W: +14.05%), AMAT (1W: +13.62%); note MAJOR DIVERGENCE across large-cap names (multiple 1W/1M mismatches) — tactical moves, not broad confirmations.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed with narrow leadership: several megacap semis and platforms ABOVE TREND (INTC, AMD, META) while ORCL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND and INTU (1W: -12.89% | 1M: -25.08%) BELOW TREND show dispersion; sector-level 1W up but participation thin.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials weak: JPM (1W: -3.08% | 1M: -5.08%) BELOW TREND and broad sector 1W negative, so Financials are not leading the market rotation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Patchy but actionable: PFE (1W: +3.46% | 1M: +1.57%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +3.87% | 1M: -5.22%) RECOVERY on strong news, while UNH (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -5.38%) BELOW TREND; sector shows idiosyncratic, news-driven pockets of strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective exposure to clear leaders in this narrow tech rally (INTC, AMD, META) and to specific healthcare names showing news-driven momentum (PFE, LLY); reduce exposure to names showing sustained downside and negative sentiment (ORCL, INTU, UPS). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and weak breadth; treat positions tactically.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +15.44% | 1M: +31.32%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +14.05% | 1M: +36.51%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through.  
BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -12.89% | 1M: -25.08%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -8.11% | 1M: -12.45%) BELOW TREND — watch downside continuation.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology and Healthcare (the two positive sectors in current breadth).  
BEARISH: Financials, Industrials, Communication and Energy given broad 1W weakness across those sectors; Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch for follow-through above this week’s highs in INTC and AMD as confirmation of the tech spike; monitor whether META holds its weekly gains to sustain ABOVE TREND status; watch ORCL and INTU failing to reclaim short-term levels as confirmation of ongoing weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
LLY (+85): headline on massive weight-loss win; LLY (1W: +3.87% | 1M: -5.22%) RECOVERY — sentiment confirmed by 1W lift but 1M lag.  
AMGN (+85): positive Phase 3 data; AMGN (1W: +7.89% | 1M: -8.52%) RECOVERY — news-driven bounce, monitor follow-through.  
META (+55): AI progress headlines; META (1W: +14.05% | 1M: +36.51%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price strongly confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ORCL (-50): force majeure at AI data center; ORCL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and price weakening.  
UPS (-60): lost Amazon volume headlines; UPS (1W: -8.11% | 1M: -12.45%) BELOW TREND — confirmed downside.  
CCI (-50): dividend cut headlines; CCI (1W: -7.63% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and weak breadth (2/11 sectors positive). INTC, AMD and META showing relative strength (INTC ABOVE TREND; AMD ABOVE TREND; META ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major 1W/1M divergences and negative sentiment on ORCL and UPS — watch for failure of follow-through before treating rallies as durable.
